# Wellfound Jobs Scraper & API - AngelList Startup Jobs, Equity

> Wellfound jobs scraper and API for wellfound.com, formerly AngelList Talent: startup jobs by role, place and remote, newest first, with salary, equity, company stage and size.

## Summary

Wellfound Jobs Scraper (Apify actor anshumanatrey/wellfound-jobs-search) searches Wellfound, the startup job board that was AngelList Talent, and returns each job's title, startup, places, remote or office setting, pay and equity, years of experience, startup size, stage and badges, posting date and link, newest first. It reads every page of a Wellfound search (role, place, role at a place, remote) and sorts the jobs by the moment each went live, where other Wellfound actors read 1 to 10 pages in Wellfound's own order. Typed titles go through Wellfound's 518 roles and typed places through its 473 place pages, so "software engineer" in "Bangalore" or "Remote India" works as typed. Full details add the description, visa sponsorship, relocation, preferred time zones, skills, the startup's website, markets and funding. No login, no API key, no proxy by default.

## Key features

- Every page of each Wellfound search read, then newest first by the moment a job went live (or was reposted)
- Pay and equity parsed into numbers with their currency; startup size, stage (early, growth, scale, public) and badges (YC Funded, Top Investors, Valuation $1B+) on every row
- One job title is enough; an empty form returns the newest jobs on all of Wellfound (578 search pages, about a minute)
- Places as people type them: San Francisco, NYC, Bangalore or Bengaluru, California, Germany, Europe, EMEA, Remote India, Worldwide
- Filters: remote, hybrid or onsite; job type (full-time, contract, intern, cofounder); years of experience; lowest yearly pay in any currency; startup stage; leave-out words
- Full details: visa sponsorship, relocation, time zones, skills, markets, funding (amount, rounds, newest round and its month), places with region and country
- Job link check: open, closed (taken down) or not found
- Pay per delivered row; a spending limit stops a run cleanly with the jobs it paid for

## Pricing

PAY_PER_EVENT model, platform usage included:

- Job: $0.000013 per saved job ($0.013 per 1,000), and per checked link that is closed or not found
- Job with details: $0.0002 per saved job with full details on ($0.20 per 1,000)
- Run start: $0.0079 per GB of memory, charged by Apify when a run starts, so $0.0079 at the default 512 MB

Wellfound Jobs Scraper's Apify Store header shows the lowest discount-tier price, the GOLD price: $0.01 per 1,000 jobs. FREE users (Apify's Free plan) pay $0.000013 a job and $0.0002 with full details, BRONZE (Starter) $0.000013 and $0.0002, SILVER (Scale) $0.000011 and $0.00016, and GOLD (Business) and the enterprise tiers $0.00001 and $0.00012. The run start is a flat fee on every plan.

Typical costs (Free plan price, default memory):

- 100 newest jobs: $0.0092
- 100 jobs with full details: $0.028
- 1,000 jobs: $0.021
- Every job of the last 30 days, 4,060 on 2026-11-10: $0.061

Apify's free $5 monthly credit covers about 54,000 jobs in runs of 100.

## Speed

Measured on Apify at the default 512 MB on 2026-11-10: the example input (software engineer, 89 search pages) 9.5 s, the empty form (every job on Wellfound, 578 pages) 60 s, product manager in New York City 3.5 s, every job of the last 30 days (4,060 rows) 72 s with a 238 MB memory peak. Full details open one job page per job, and Wellfound slows one address down after about 60 of them: 100 jobs with details took 274 s without a proxy and 135 s with Apify Proxy.

## When to use

- New startup jobs by title, city, remote setting, pay and equity, every day
- Recruiters and talent teams tracking which startups hire for a role, at what stage and pay
- Sales and venture research: startups hiring by market, stage and funding, with their websites
- AI agents and data pipelines that need a clean Wellfound jobs feed through the API or MCP

## When NOT to use

- Every job of one startup: Wellfound shows visitors at most 3 jobs of a startup in a search, and its company pages sit behind a browser check
- Only the jobs new since your last run, with alerts: other Wellfound actors offer that; schedule this one with postedWithin 24 hours instead

## Sample inputs

```json
{
  "searchTerms": ["software engineer"],
  "location": ["New York City", "Remote"],
  "minSalary": "150k USD",
  "postedWithin": "7 days",
  "maxJobs": 100
}
```

## Sample output (one record)

```json
{
  "title": "Staff Software Engineer (Applied AI)",
  "company": "Traba",
  "location": "New York City",
  "otherLocations": ["San Francisco"],
  "workType": "onsite",
  "employmentType": "full-time",
  "salary": "USD 240,000 - 300,000 per year",
  "postedAt": "2026-11-10T00:37:18Z",
  "jobUrl": "https://wellfound.com/jobs/5027476-staff-software-engineer-applied-ai",
  "status": "open",
  "platform": "wellfound",
  "jobId": "5027476",
  "salaryMin": 240000,
  "salaryMax": 300000,
  "salaryCurrency": "USD",
  "offersEquity": true,
  "equityMin": 0.13,
  "equityMax": 0.24,
  "companySize": "51-200",
  "companyBadges": ["Actively Hiring", "Growing fast"]
}
```

## Keys (input)

- Job titles to find (searchTerms), Where the job is (location), Remote or office (workType), Job type (employmentType), Posted in the last (postedWithin), Number of jobs (maxJobs), Full details (includeDetails), Leave out words (excludeTerms), Lowest yearly pay (minSalary), Company stage (companyStage), Experience (experienceYears), Descriptions too (searchDescriptions), Only these startups (companies), Job links to check (jobUrls), Connection (proxyConfiguration)

## Differentiators vs alternatives

- vs blackfalcondata/wellfound-scraper: reads every page of a search and sorts it newest first; no residential proxy by default
- vs memo23/wellfound-jobs-scraper: startup stage, size and badges and parsed pay and equity on every plain row; job link check
- vs clearpath/wellfound-api-ppe: typed titles and places instead of search URLs; every page read instead of 1 by default
